import.title: Import customers
import.description: Upload a spreadsheet of restaurants you already supply. We match each row to Supplify accounts automatically so you can connect, invite, or sponsor them from the list below.
import.step1: Download the example CSV or use your own file with the columns below.
import.step2: Choose a file — we validate rows and show a preview before anything is saved.
import.step3: Run import — matched restaurants appear in Imported customers for your next step.
import.csvColumnList: Restaurant Name, Contact Person, Phone, Email, Address, Area/Region, Credit Limit, Payment Terms, Sales Representative, Notes
import.csvHelp: Restaurant Name is required. Email or phone helps us match existing Supplify accounts. All other columns are optional but useful for your records.

prospects.title: Imported customers
prospects.description: Restaurants from your import, with their match status on Supplify. For restaurants already on the platform, send a connection request. For everyone else, share an invite link or sponsor them with a one-month gift subscription.
prospects.sponsorLimit_one: Up to {{count}} gift per year on your supplier plan
prospects.sponsorLimit_other: Up to {{count}} gifts per year on your supplier plan
prospects.sponsorHelp: Sponsoring gives a restaurant one free month of Supplify {{plan}} — they can order from you on the platform with full plan features. After the gift month they choose whether to subscribe; they may still qualify for your referral discount.
prospects.errorDescription: Check your connection and try again.
prospects.empty: No customers imported yet. Upload a CSV above — after import, each restaurant will show here with options to connect, invite, or sponsor.
prospects.actionsHelp: Connect — already on Supplify; sends a follow request they must accept. Invite — copies a signup link with your referral benefits. Sponsor — starts their one-month {{plan}} gift immediately.
